source.japanese:
冒険の中断が正しく行われなかったため
地上から再開することになりました
アイテムもゴールドもなくなり
ダンジョンで倒れたことになります

entries.english:
Your adventure wasn't suspended
properly. You'll restart on the surface
with no items or gold. This counts as
a dungeon defeat.
entries.review: Preserve the distinct damaged/unloadable adventure log and improperly suspended adventure, surface restart, loss of both items and gold, and counting as a dungeon defeat. Match the original two/four explicit rows. No save mechanics or corruption handling changed.

source.japanese:

entries.english:
Your adventure log is damaged
and couldn't be loaded.
entries.review: Preserve the distinct damaged/unloadable adventure log and improperly suspended adventure, surface restart, loss of both items and gold, and counting as a dungeon defeat. Match the original two/four explicit rows. No save mechanics or corruption handling changed.

scope: Two independently audited native save-error modal readers. Only literals14E20 and15058 redirect immutable-ROM messages; original save validation, state changes and files remain unchanged. Rendering probes do not establish natural corruption/suspension failure.
